v36_fixed_eight.limitations: 同 checkpoint 只有 PBRS Critic，没有独立原始任务 Critic；自然 Web 状态没有完整训练 reward ledger / 隐藏 aux 映射，不能计算严格原始/塑形 Q1/A1/ΔA。未找到 v36 历史训练 trajectory；不能用 v35 轨迹或新评估局冒充。
v36_fixed_eight.critical_scope: Current logic approximate diagnosis; never training-time reward or strict A1

je10_selection.rule: zero observed self harm first; maximize geometric mean of natural delivery/16, seven route delivery/112, Tactical safe kills/64, pooled Hunter safe kills/192; ties lexical round then generation. Exploratory selection, not significance or admission.
